excludedSameNameDefinitions.description: Greatly improved accuracy and range on the opening shot of attack.

ddc.rawHTML:
157
Opening Shot
Grants the following bonuses for the first shot (of the burst):
Primary/Power Weapons: +25 +30 Range, +20 +25 Aim Assist, -5% Accuracy Cone Size, and -10% Accuracy Cone Growth.
Special Weapons: +13 ↑+15 Range, +10 +13 Aim Assist, -2.5% Accuracy Cone Size, and -5% Accuracy Cone Growth.
Incurs a 3 second cooldown after shooting.

↑Grants additional Aim Assist and Range.

policies.defaultSelection: No trait selected by default; master registers only these exact base rolls. Enhanced/exotic unsupported.
policies.ownership: Original count-one selected hotbar/equipped object, exact canonical entry and selected tuple; ServerPlayer/level/GuardianData/runtime/class/loadout/Super checked; accepted writers only; no query mutation. Old-owner cleanup cannot remove successor.
policies.integration: Master owns shared registry/runtime/aiming/handling/HUD and central tests. Token.NONE for perkSplash; never fresh capture at explosion.
policies.conversion: 20TPS elapsed server ticks are a provisional Minecraft mapping, not a measured Destiny clock.
policies.aa: Sourced Aim Assist metadata is exposed only. This server port has no AA or client magnetism implementation.
policies.validation: Focused event/timer/epoch cycle tests and isolated Java25 compile only; no numeric mirror tests, numeric-only Vision/fullgate, native or server QA.
policies.paid: capture(p,entry,firstOfBurst) after each actual ammo payment before trace. Every paid emission restarts 60 ticks, including firstOfBurst=false supplementals; never fresh supplemental bonuses.
policies.application: rangeBonus adds to existing raw Range before single master clamp; accuracyScalar/growthScalar multiply existing cone/growth; aimAssistBonus metadata only.
policies.snapshot: Paid immutable bonus survives natural cooldown and later shots. Stow revokes tokens but retains last-shot timing; source edit/change/lifecycle permanently revokes epoch.
policies.uncertainty: Primary/Power and Special values confirmed in DDC row157; exact native same-tick boundary and cross-stow cooldown are local event policies.
